newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Dec 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Dec 11.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The practice of issuing bad cheques in Jeddah has fallen by more than 60 percent during the last two months, according to director of the trade department at Jeddah chamber of commerce.
- Saudi Eastern chamber of commerce offers 16 investment projects worth two billion riyals.
- Mecca Construction Company expects its income to reach 214 million riyals in 1997.
- Syria invests $30 million in two tourism projects.
